region_selection_policy.region_1_opening: First unit with preview_absence_reason or opening preview <= 40 chars clipped before unit end; otherwise first paragraph unit in source order.
region_selection_policy.region_2_anchor_or_partial_cue: First distinct unit with quote_introduction_candidate anchor, partial anchor visibility, or unshown anchors (> display limit); otherwise first distinct unit with any anchor (or heading-only source anchor if present); fallback to middle unit.
region_selection_policy.region_3_parent_neighbor_window: First distinct unit with repeated/jumped marker neighbor, quoted role, intervening heading in expansion envelope, or unnumbered kind; fallback to 2/3 position unit.

rng_method: Python random.Random(20261105).sample on sorted eligible case IDs for uniform_random_20; deterministic metadata-threshold ranking with shared selected_set deduplication for risk_stratified_20

risk_1_anchors_exceeding_display_limit.criterion: over_display_units >= 3 and unshown_anchors_total >= 10, sorted by (-unshown_anchors_total, -over_display_units, case_id)

risk_2_long_cross_unit_or_heading_cues.criterion: heading_only_cues > 0 or cross_unit_cues > 0 or long_cues (>=120 bytes) > 0, sorted by (-heading_only_cues, -cross_unit_cues, -max_cue_bytes, case_id)

risk_3_very_short_abbrev_or_placeholder_.criterion: units_without_preview > 0 or short_opening_units (<=25 chars clipped before unit end) >= 2, sorted by (-units_without_preview, -short_opening_units, case_id)

risk_4_repeated_markers_quotations_unnum.criterion: repeated_markers >= 2 and quoted_units >= 1 and unnumbered_units >= 1, sorted by (-repeated_markers, -quoted_units, -unnumbered_units, case_id)

risk_5_very_long_or_heading_dense_source.criterion: approx_byte_length >= 80000 and headings >= 20 and navigation_units >= 120, sorted by (-headings, -approx_byte_length, case_id)
